newsitem.title: USA: Manugistics in 2.2 million share offering.
newsitem.headline: Manugistics in 2.2 million share offering.

text.p: Manugistics Group Inc said on Thursday that it filed a registration statement for the proposed offering of 2.2 million common shares.
Manugistics said in a news release that 1.8 million of the shares will be offered by the company and 400,000 by a selling stockholder.

Net company proceeds were to be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, including financing further expansion into international markets, acceleration of product releases and possible acquisitions.
Managing underwriters for the offering were to be Alex. Brown & Sons, Morgan Stanley and Robertson, Stephens & Co.
Manugistics develops software for synchronized supply chain management. Its shares were down 1-1/2 to 44-1/2 in morning Nasdaq trading.
